name: Coldframe Corporate Media Solutions
description: Operating behind a deliberately bland corporate identity, Coldframe is Vantablack Media's dedicated B2B arm, producing neural-feed training content, onboarding immersions, and compliance programming for corponation clients across the Meridian stack. Their catalog includes mandatory safety orientation feeds, productivity enhancement modules, and the widely-used 'Axiom Ready' workforce conditioning series licensed to HelixCorp, Axiom, and dozens of smaller corponations. Workers in Tier 2-3 employment often log hundreds of hours in Coldframe-produced content annually without knowing the studio's name.
cultural_impact: Coldframe's ubiquity in workplace onboarding has made the phrase 'running a Coldframe' into Meridian slang for any interaction that feels scripted, performative, or designed to manufacture consent.
story_hooks: A labor organizer obtains a leaked Coldframe module intended only for Tier 4 managerial staff — and discovers it contains behavioral profiling tools designed to identify workers likely to organize.
A Coldframe content designer begins secretly embedding micro-variations into compliance modules that subtly undermine the messaging they are meant to deliver.
A character undergoes mandatory Coldframe onboarding and begins experiencing intrusive memories that don't belong to them, suggesting the module contained residual neural data from a previous user.
